title: BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent within India, directly impacting the future performance of Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be conducted at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.
